sections.Profile:
"Big House" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1989. The game features a prison escape theme with two flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 80B series, it was designed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell, and a production run of 1,977 units.
